model_routing: Use the least expensive capable model after risk classification; declare context, output, fanout and tool-call ceilings. Model choice never grants authority or counts as verification.
quality_gate: All applicable mandatory scenarios require fresh passing evidence; waivers are scoped, compensating and expiring.
exposure_gate: Consumers project people, operations, economic value and data exposed during RTO/RPO. Exceeding any approved limit requires a shorter recovery target or verified impact reduction; non-relaxable safety floors remain independent of volume.
forbidden_inferences: Stale evidence proves the current revision
